starter_files.contents:
# Reusable PHP Package

Develop a PHP library that another developer can install and test independently.

## Setup
Install a supported PHP 8.5.x runtime. Add Composer only when required by the milestones. Copy the configuration example, supply local-only credentials via environment variables, and never commit secrets.

## Status
Starter outline only; complete the milestones and acceptance criteria before considering this project finished.

stretch_features: Add an integration test for a failure case.
Document one architectural decision and its trade-off.
Check PHP/dependency compatibility and record the commands used to reproduce the build.

tests.name: Required feature checks
criteria: Each required feature is demonstrated with evidence.
Normal, invalid, and boundary cases are tested.
Errors do not falsely report successful completion.

tests.name: Security review
criteria: Input, output, access control, and file/database boundaries are reviewed.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: Setup instructions work on a clean local environment.
Tests and validation commands are documented.

status_note: Project brief and starter material are provided; a human reviewer must verify implementation behavior and security before publication.
